text:
anna_billing: Heads up — noticed 3 customers with duplicate credit adjustments in NetSuite after a Stripe webhook replay this morning. Strange: invoices unaffected, but adjustment JE created twice for same payment_id.

maria_finance: ugh. any invoice ids or example?

anna_billing: yes — cust A: INV-3921, payment stripe_pi_3Jx..., two adjustment lines of -$120 each. attaching logs below.

anna_billing: log snippet: ```
webhook_event.id=evt_1Jxabc
headers: Stripe-Signature: t=1610000000,v1=xxx
consumer: ns-sync-service POST /webhooks/stripe 200 OK
processing: create_adjustment(payment_id=stripe_pi_3Jx..., external_ref=null)
```

josh_eng: quick q: do we dedupe on event.id today?

anna_billing: we check event.id in redis for 5m and ignore repeats — but these were in quick succession after a partial failure and later replayed by Stripe 10m later. looks like dedupe key expired?

josh_eng: that'd explain it. if the first attempt created the JE but failed to persist the stripe_event_id custom field on the JE (rollback path), a later replay could create a second JE because the check reads the invoice custom field, not a separate events table.

leo_ops: stripe-bot posted DLQ alert at 2026-11-03T09:12:05Z about webhook delivery failure -> retried from queue, sequence numbers: 102, 103, 110 (gap).

ns-sync-bot: FYI the NetSuite API returned intermittent 500s during the window; some writes were retried client-side. we don't currently perform a strict event-id upsert for adjustments.

maria_finance: what's the proposed fix? manual cleanup will be tedious.

josh_eng: short-term: create a compensating reversal JE for duplicates and mark the original JE rows with a custom field stripe_event_id. long-term: change webhook consumer to be strictly idempotent by persisting stripe_event_id in a durable events table (db upsert) before creating JE. if the API call to NetSuite fails later, the event is still marked processed so replay won't recreate.

anna_billing: can we also add a guard that refuses to create an adjustment if a JE exists with same payment_id + amount in the last 24h? safety net.

josh_eng: yes, add that rule as fallback. also increase redis TTL on current dedupe to 1h while we ship DB upsert.

leo_ops: I'll patch the consumer helm chart to bump TTL and add a feature flag for strict-idempotency. push ETA: today EOD for TTL change, next week for db-upsert PR.

maria_finance: manual steps for finance to reconcile? what do you need from us?

anna_billing: need a list of duplicate JE ids + invoice ids so we can void reversals and notify customers. I'll run a query but would appreciate an export of NetSuite rows for the event window.

ns-sync-bot: Query to find candidates (run in NetSuite saved search): filter: created >= 2026-11-03T09:00:00Z AND created <= 2026-11-03T10:00:00Z AND memo contains 'stripe_pi' AND amount < 0. Sort by memo, amount.

anna_billing: running now, will paste CSV in a follow-up message.

josh_eng: longer-term: add schema: events(event_id PK, event_type, payload_hash, received_at, processed_at, outcome, net_suite_journal_id). Then consumer flow: upsert event -> if new then process -> on success mark processed. That handles duplicates and replay.

maria_finance: happy with that. also request we add an alert when same invoice has >1 JE adjustments within 1h.

leo_ops: will add alert to PagerDuty rule and a Grafana dashboard panel for duplicate adjustments metric.

anna_billing: thanks. immediate actions: 1) leo bump TTL today EOD, 2) josh open PR for DB upsert + fallback guard, 3) anna will share CSV for manual reversals, 4) operations to add alert. tagging @here for visibility. :thumbsup:

josh_eng: PR link: https://git.internal/redwood/ns-sync/pull/482 (draft) — includes redis TTL bump and feature flag. please review.

maria_finance: when do we run cleanup? can do after PR merged and we confirm no new dupes for 24h.

anna_billing: agreed. I'll coordinate with support to queue customer emails after reversals are posted.

leo_ops: logging note: also capture Stripe delivery attempt id (Event-Delivery-Id header) in event record to aid postmortem.

anna_billing: CSV uploaded: /shared/finance/stripe-dup-adjustments-20261103.csv

maria_finance: confirmed, got it. starting reversal process now. ping if you need approval for write ops.

anna_billing: will post status later. thanks everyone.
